During the reign [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fandar (pirate)|Fandar]] ran a [[Fandar's pirate organization|group]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], with the assistance of his '''right-hand man'''. Fandar teamed up with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to raid an Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]], but Fandar's right-hand man betrayed them, and the lured his commander and an Alliance force into an ambush.<ref name="Pirate" />
